1a44f6f4-b6d1-4fc1-8ec6-c625c947a0be/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> burst out from the Land of Blackstones,<NL>and in a moment every sound around fell away.<NL><NL>Crimson flames burned the clouds, streams of fire flying through the air. A burning wind struck the face, and scorching waves seared all around,<NL>and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> stood now upon a lone island within a great fire-pool beneath the earth...
1a44f6f4-b6d1-4fc1-8ec6-c625c947a0be/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>自玄石之境飞离而出，<NL>顷刻间，周遭声响尽散，<NL><NL>眼前但见赤焰烧云，流火飞溅，又觉炎风扑面，灼浪烧人，<NL>自己竟是置身于一处地底火池的孤岛之上……

d04da080-6cc1-412c-88cc-0be50024aebf/Eve.en: As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> wonders, they suddenly see in the center of the lonely island,<NL>scattered remnants of petals like blood, a red figure lying quietly among them...
d04da080-6cc1-412c-88cc-0be50024aebf/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>疑惑之际，却忽见孤岛中央，<NL>遍地残瓣如血，一抹红影静卧其间……
d04da080-6cc1-412c-88cc-0be50024aebf/Eve.ru: Как <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> чудеса, они вдруг видят в центре одинокого острова,<NL>разбросанные остатки лепестков, похожие на кровь, и красную фигуру, спокойно лежащую среди них...

8a57bcaf-e925-45dd-b475-9cbccb49132e/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s heart tightens, they swiftly fly closer—<NL>seeing Long Yufu lying on her back among the withered petals,<NL>her face pale, eyes tightly shut, breath barely perceptible, as if most of her True Qi has been expended...<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> gently lifts Long Yufu,<NL>Long Yufu slowly opens her eyes, and upon seeing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, her gaze suddenly brightens...
8a57bcaf-e925-45dd-b475-9cbccb49132e/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心头一紧，飞身掠至近处——<NL>只见龙语茯仰面躺在凋残的花瓣之间，<NL>面色惨白，双眸紧阖，气息微不可闻，似已损耗大半真气……<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>立时将龙语茯轻轻扶起，<NL>只见龙语茯悠悠睁开双目，见得<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，眼眸倏然一亮……

8a57bcaf-e925-45dd-b475-9cbccb49132e/Opt.en: Just now in the Land of Blackstones, it was you who lent the helping hand?
8a57bcaf-e925-45dd-b475-9cbccb49132e/Opt.cn: 适才玄石之境，是你出手相助？
8a57bcaf-e925-45dd-b475-9cbccb49132e/Opt.ru: Только что в Стране Блэкстоунов именно вы протянули руку помощи?

972d72f9-c66e-4a84-9452-c1b8a3a8f415/Eve.en: "Hmph! You... carry the blood of the True Demon in your veins, the very key to becoming the True Demon...<NL>Had you been trapped in the Land of Blackstones, my long years of effort would have come to nothing."<NL><NL>Long Yufu turned her eyes away, a touch of awkwardness on her face,<NL>and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, seeing she would not say more, asked no further...
972d72f9-c66e-4a84-9452-c1b8a3a8f415/Eve.cn: “哼！你……身负真魔之血，乃是成就真魔的关键……<NL>若是困在玄石之境，我多年心血，岂不尽付东流。”<NL><NL>龙语茯别开视线，脸上颇有尴尬之色，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>见她不愿多言，便也不再追问……

972d72f9-c66e-4a84-9452-c1b8a3a8f415/Opt.en: This kindness shall be remembered. Yet Huanxin came forth from the Land of Blackstones with me. Why is she not here?
972d72f9-c66e-4a84-9452-c1b8a3a8f415/Opt.cn: 此番恩情，自当铭记，只是我与焕心同出玄石之境，何以她不在此处？
972d72f9-c66e-4a84-9452-c1b8a3a8f415/Opt.ru: Я запомню эту доброту. И все же Хуаньсинь пришла из Страны Черных камней вместе со мной. Почему ее здесь нет?

0c08e87f-8896-4dc8-8b62-cc8d3c7dc471/Eve.en: "By my own strength, it would have been barely enough to free you,<NL>and who could have known you would risk your very life to try to save that Huanxin..."<NL><NL>Long Yufu gave a soft snort, and looked at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> with a mixed gaze:<NL>"Yet calamity and fortune lie close together! It was because of your willingness to give up life for righteousness that the 'Fuyu Hilt' answered to your thought,<NL>and the 'Fuyu Hilt' in turn called upon the Fuyu Blade. The blade for a moment held the old demon Xiangshu at bay,<NL>and so you and Huanxin were given a thread of life!"
0c08e87f-8896-4dc8-8b62-cc8d3c7dc471/Eve.cn: “本来以我之力，只够勉强救你脱困，<NL>谁知你却拼着性命不要，非要去救那焕心……”<NL><NL>龙语茯轻哼一声，目光复杂地望向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>：<NL>“不过，祸福相依！正是因你舍身取义之念，令「伏虞剑柄」有所感应，<NL>而「伏虞剑柄」又引动伏虞剑刃，令那剑刃暂且制住了相枢老魔，<NL>你与焕心这才得了一线生机！”

097e70e4-05bc-4fea-981e-d34bd0003d54/Eve.en: "Yet Huanxin's body was long since eaten away by that black demon.<NL>The moment you left the Land of Blackstones, her body perished and was gone..."<NL><NL>At these words, Long Yufu reached and pressed a hand lightly upon <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s heart,<NL>a flow of crimson light running across her palm, sinking in a moment into <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s breast. A short while later her brows knit slightly, and she lifted her eyes and spoke:<NL>"Huanxin has become a thread of pure thought, sheltered by your own will. There is no great harm,<NL>only that I can feel, though her heart still holds you and all living souls in mind...<NL>at this moment she is full of anger past bearing, and finds no peace within..."
097e70e4-05bc-4fea-981e-d34bd0003d54/Eve.cn: “只是，焕心的肉身，早已遭那玄魔侵蚀，<NL>你等离开玄石之境的刹那，焕心肉身便即消亡无存……”<NL><NL>龙语茯言及此处，抬手轻按<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心口，<NL>掌间赤光流转，倏忽没入<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>胸膛，片刻后，她微蹙眉头，抬眸说道：<NL>“如今焕心已化作一缕纯粹心念，受你意念庇护，并无大碍，<NL>只不过，我能感应到，她心中虽仍牵挂着你与天下苍生……<NL>眼下却是愤恨难平，不得安宁……”

097e70e4-05bc-4fea-981e-d34bd0003d54/Opt.en: Huanxin... has become only a thread of thought... (a sorrow rose in the heart...)
097e70e4-05bc-4fea-981e-d34bd0003d54/Opt.cn: 焕心……竟已化作一缕心念……（心中一悲……）
097e70e4-05bc-4fea-981e-d34bd0003d54/Opt.ru: Хуаньсинь... стала лишь нитью мысли... (в сердце поднялась печаль...)

307d4a75-6cc1-4175-8aaf-609a3f2181f6/Eve.en: As Long Yufu's words ended,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> felt indeed, at the place of the heart, what seemed to be a clump of blood-ash stirring softly,<NL>and only when <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> lifted a hand and pressed it gently upon the heart did the blood-ash slowly settle...
307d4a75-6cc1-4175-8aaf-609a3f2181f6/Eve.cn: 随着龙语茯话音方落，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>便觉心口之处，当真似有一团血灰微微翻涌，<NL>直至<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>抬手轻抚心口，那团血灰方才渐渐平息下来……

2a1cafc0-994c-4dcb-aaa1-6ce4641a3e5a/Eve.en: "I know that, for what is in your heart, you would face a thousand perils without flinching, ten thousand and not be moved..."<NL><NL>Long Yufu pushed herself up against a rock, swaying a little, then cupped her fists in a salute:<NL>"Only, you... be sure to keep your life. What I wish for...<NL>is bound up all in all in the True Demon!"
2a1cafc0-994c-4dcb-aaa1-6ce4641a3e5a/Eve.cn: “我知你但为心中所求，千险不避，万险不移……”<NL><NL>龙语茯撑着岩石站起身来，身形微晃，随即抱拳一礼：<NL>“只是你……千万保住性命，我……我之所愿，<NL>可尽皆系于真魔之上！”

2a1cafc0-994c-4dcb-aaa1-6ce4641a3e5a/Opt.en: Where, may I ask, is this place?
2a1cafc0-994c-4dcb-aaa1-6ce4641a3e5a/Opt.ru: Где, позвольте спросить, находится это место?

2a1cafc0-994c-4dcb-aaa1-6ce4641a3e5a/Opt.en: You call me a True Demon time and again, yet since returning to the world, I have felt no stirring of the True Demon's blood at all...
2a1cafc0-994c-4dcb-aaa1-6ce4641a3e5a/Opt.cn: 你等口口声声称我真魔，可自我返回现世，便再未与真魔之血有所感应……
2a1cafc0-994c-4dcb-aaa1-6ce4641a3e5a/Opt.ru: Ты снова и снова называешь меня Истинным Демоном, но с тех пор, как я вернулся в этот мир, я совсем не чувствовал в себе крови Истинного Демона...

52dd2621-f636-4c6e-8e80-14b6f104f1c3/Eve.en: Long Yufu looked up and glanced about, her brows lifting:<NL><NL>"This is the place where that Nian Zhili lies hidden.<NL>I too was led here by your consciousness, drawn along behind.<NL>Yet your spirit-thought has now parted from your body. All that meets your eye is illusion, and need not be minded!"
52dd2621-f636-4c6e-8e80-14b6f104f1c3/Eve.cn: 龙语茯抬首环顾四周，扬眉说道：<NL><NL>“此处便是那念支离藏身之地，<NL>我也是受你神识所引，这才随来，<NL>不过你如今神念离体，眼之所见，皆是幻象，倒也不必在意！”

768dcb1e-be86-44b5-9767-9d72e849c675/Eve.en: "The dragon lies hidden in the deep, but when it rises, it must reach the nine heavens!<NL>The blood of the True Demon is hidden within your very being. You could not cast it off if you tried,<NL>and when the hour comes, the True Demon shall appear once more!"
768dcb1e-be86-44b5-9767-9d72e849c675/Eve.cn: “潜龙在渊，腾必九天！<NL>真魔之血伏藏于你体内，你便是想弃也弃不掉，<NL>时机一旦成熟，真魔自会再现！”
768dcb1e-be86-44b5-9767-9d72e849c675/Eve.ru: "Дракон скрывается в глубине, но когда он поднимется, то должен достичь девяти небес!<NL>Кровь Истинного Демона сокрыта в самом твоем существе. Ты не сможешь избавиться от него, даже если попытаешься,<NL>и когда придет час, Истинный Демон появится снова!"

768dcb1e-be86-44b5-9767-9d72e849c675/Opt.en: Bide the hour... and the True Demon shall appear...
768dcb1e-be86-44b5-9767-9d72e849c675/Opt.ru: Жди своего часа... и явится Истинный Демон...

827605e5-3c52-4b73-a510-eeb519d88608/Eve.en: Before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s words had ended,<NL>a wave of cold rose from the heart and rushed through every limb. It was like falling into an ice-cellar.<NL>Then ten and more streams of warmth came from sources unknown, flowing into the body by turns. Like spring waters refreshing all things, they wrapped around <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s heart-meridian,<NL>and in that moment, cold and warmth contended within the body.<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s consciousness gathered and dispersed by turns, the scene before the eyes growing now bright, now dim...
827605e5-3c52-4b73-a510-eeb519d88608/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>话音未落，<NL>只觉一股寒气自心口涌出，直冲四肢百骸，霎时间如坠冰窖，<NL>忽而又有十余道来处各异的暖流，断续注入体内，如春水润物，护住<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心脉，<NL>一时之间，体内一寒一暖，二力交争，<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>但觉神智时聚时散，眼前景物忽明忽暗……

8624c2c8-ebeb-49ef-a1bc-56db90609edb/Eve.en: "This is no good! Your spirit has been parted from the body too long. The body in the world below is about to perish!"<NL><NL>Long Yufu, seeing the strangeness come over <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, turned grim in a moment, and heedless of her own wounds,<NL>flashed forward, both palms thrust out, and pressed them hard against the back of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s heart, calling out sharply:<NL><NL>"Draw your spirit back at once!"
8624c2c8-ebeb-49ef-a1bc-56db90609edb/Eve.cn: “不好！你神念离体太久，现世肉身将陨！”<NL><NL>龙语茯眼见<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>异状，登时神色一凛，顾不得自身伤势，<NL>身形一闪，双掌齐出，猛地抵住<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>后心，厉声喝道：<NL><NL>“速速返神归元！”
